Generated Narrative: ValueSet mii-vs-mikrobio-mrgn-klasse-loinc

This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Include these codes as defined in http://loinc.org version 📍2.82
    CodeDisplay
    LA33214-02MRGN
    LA33215-73MRGN
    LA33216-54MRGN
  • Include these codes as defined in https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/modul-mikrobio/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mikrobio-mrgn-ergebnis version 📦2027.0.0-ballot2
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    keine-mrgn-klasseKeine MRGN-KlasseThe identified Gram-negative isolate was assessed on the basis of the available susceptibility results and cannot be assigned to any MRGN class (2MRGN, 3MRGN, 4MRGN). To be distinguished from the negative result of a targeted pathogen detection, which is represented by MII_PR_Mikrobio_Spezifische_Bestimmung or MII_PR_Mikrobio_Spezifische_Kultur.

name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_MRGN_Klasse_LOINC
title: MII VS Microbiology MRGN Class [LOINC]
description: Result ValueSet for the MRGN classification: 2MRGN, 3MRGN and 4MRGN according to the RKI categorisation. The negative classification is in the module's own CodeSystem, because the LOINC answer list does not carry it.
